text_en: In the one hundred fifty-first year Demetrius son of Seleucus set out from Rome, sailed with a few men to a town by the sea, and there began to reign.
text_cn: 一百五十一年，色娄苛的儿子德默特琉，逃离罗马，带着少数几个人，在沿海的一座城登陆，在那里称王。

text_en: As he was entering the royal palace of his ancestors, the army seized Antiochus and Lysias to bring them to him.
text_cn: 当他要进入祖先王宫时，他的军队将安提约古和里息雅逮捕了，要给他解来。

text_en: But when this act became known to him, he said, “Do not let me see their faces! ”
text_cn: 但他一听说这事，就说：“你们不要让我见他们的面。”

text_en: So the army killed them, and Demetrius took his seat on the throne of his kingdom.
text_cn: 军队便将他们杀了；德默特琉于是坐上了本国的王位。

text_en: Then there came to him all the renegade and godless men of Israel; they were led by Alcimus, who wanted to be high priest.
text_cn: 那时，一般无法无天的以色列人，以想作大司祭的阿耳基慕为首，竟来到王跟前，

text_en: They brought to the king this accusation against the people: “Judas and his brothers have destroyed all your Friends, and have driven us out of our land.
text_cn: 控告自己的百姓说：“犹大和他的兄弟们，杀害了你所有的朋友，也使我们离开本国。

text_en: Now then send a man whom you trust; let him go and see all the ruin that Judas has brought on us and on the land of the king, and let him punish them and all who help them. ”
text_cn: 现在，请派遣你信赖的人，去看看他们加于我们及王国的一切破坏情形，然后对他们和他们的助手处以惩罚。”

text_en: So the king chose Bacchides, one of the king’s Friends, governor of the province Beyond the River; he was a great man in the kingdom and was faithful to the king.
text_cn: 王便从自己的朋友中选了巴基德；他原是河西的总督， 国家的一位要人，且忠于君王。

text_en: He sent him, and with him he sent the ungodly Alcimus, whom he made high priest; and he commanded him to take vengeance on the Israelites.
text_cn: 王派他与恶棍阿耳基慕同去，且委任阿耳基慕为大司祭，叫他向以色列子民复仇。

text_en: So they marched away and came with a large force into the land of Judah; and he sent messengers to Judas and his brothers with peaceable but treacherous words.
text_cn: 他们带着大军动身到了犹太地，就打发使者，向犹大及其兄弟们和谈，欺骗他们；

text_en: But they paid no attention to their words, for they saw that they had come with a large force.
text_cn: 不过他们并不理会那些人的话，因为已看出他们带着大军而来的用意。

text_en: Then a group of scribes appeared in a body before Alcimus and Bacchides to ask for just terms.
text_cn: 无如，经师团竟集体去见阿耳基慕和巴基德，要求公正调解。

text_en: The Hasideans were first among the Israelites to seek peace from them,
text_cn: 其次，在以色列平民中，首先是哈息待人来向他们求和，

text_en: for they said, “A priest of the line of Aaron has come with the army, and he will not harm us. ”
text_cn: 因为他们想：“来者是位亚郎后裔的司祭，他虽然带着军队，但决不会加害我们。”

text_en: Alcimus spoke peaceable words to them and swore this oath to them, “We will not seek to injure you or your friends. ”
text_cn: 阿耳基慕遂向他们说了一些亲善的话，还发誓说：“我们决不谋害你们及你们的朋友！”

text_en: So they trusted him; but he seized sixty of them and killed them in one day, in accordance with the word that was written,
text_cn: 他们便信了他的话。那料想阿耳基慕竟捕去他们六十人，在一天之内将他们都杀死，应验了经上这句话：

text_en: “The flesh of your faithful ones and their blood they poured out all around Jerusalem, and there was no one to bury them. ”
text_cn: “在耶路撒冷四周，他们分散了你圣者的肉体，倾流了他们的血，无人埋葬。”

text_en: Then the fear and dread of them fell on all the people, for they said, “There is no truth or justice in them, for they have violated the agreement and the oath that they swore. ”
text_cn: 于是，恐怖战栗笼罩着整个百姓；遂说：“这些人没有真理，没有正义，违犯了盟约，背弃了发过的誓言。”

text_en: Then Bacchides withdrew from Jerusalem and encamped in Beth-zaith. And he sent and seized many of the men who had deserted to him, and some of the people, and killed them and threw them into a great pit.
text_cn: 那时，巴基德从耶路撒冷出发，在贝特斋特安营， 打发人将许多逃来跟从他的人，和一些平民拘捕杀害，投在大坑里。

text_en: He placed Alcimus in charge of the country and left with him a force to help him; then Bacchides went back to the king.
text_cn: 然后把这地委托给阿耳基慕管理，又给他留下军队协助他；巴基德就回到王那里去了。

text_en: Alcimus struggled to maintain his high priesthood,
text_cn: 阿耳基慕仍为作大司祭而活动；

text_en: and all who were troubling their people joined him. They gained control of the land of Judah and did great damage in Israel.
text_cn: 那些扰乱自己百姓的人，都同他联合，占据了犹太地，在以色列中酿成大祸。

text_en: And Judas saw all the wrongs that Alcimus and those with him had done among the Israelites; it was more than the Gentiles had done.
text_cn: 犹大见阿耳基慕及跟从他的人，对以色列子民所行的一切，比异民还坏，

text_en: So Judas went out into all the surrounding parts of Judea, taking vengeance on those who had deserted and preventing those in the city from going out into the country.
text_cn: 便出巡犹太四境，对叛徒采取报复，阻止他们到乡间去。

text_en: When Alcimus saw that Judas and those with him had grown strong, and realized that he could not withstand them, he returned to the king and brought malicious charges against them.
text_cn: 阿耳基慕一见犹大和他的同伴力量强大，自知不能抵抗，就回到王前，控告他们许多罪行。

text_en: Then the king sent Nicanor, one of his honored princes, who hated and detested Israel, and he commanded him to destroy the people.
text_cn: 王的一位名将尼加诺尔，很仇恨以色列人，王就派遣他，命他去歼灭这百姓。

text_en: So Nicanor came to Jerusalem with a large force, and treacherously sent to Judas and his brothers this peaceable message,
text_cn: 尼加诺尔率领大军，一来到耶路撒冷，便派人去见犹大和他的兄弟们，诈言和谈说：

text_en: “Let there be no fighting between you and me; I shall come with a few men to see you face to face in peace. ”
text_cn: “愿你我之间，没有战争。我愿同少数人来，与你们和平会面。”

text_en: So he came to Judas, and they greeted one another peaceably; but the enemy were preparing to kidnap Judas.
text_cn: 于是尼加诺尔去见犹大，彼此和气地请了安；可是敌人已准备好要劫持犹大。

text_en: It became known to Judas that Nicanor had come to him with treacherous intent, and he was afraid of him and would not meet him again.
text_cn: 犹大一知他来意不善，就非常害怕，不愿再见他的面。

text_en: When Nicanor learned that his plan had been disclosed, he went out to meet Judas in battle near Caphar-salama.
text_cn: 尼加诺尔知道自己的计谋已被识破，就出去，在加法撒拉玛对面，和犹大交战。

text_en: About five hundred of the army of Nicanor fell, and the rest fled into the city of David.
text_cn: 这次尼加诺尔的军队死的，约有五百人，其余的人都逃到达味城里。

text_en: After these events Nicanor went up to Mount Zion. Some of the priests from the sanctuary and some of the elders of the people came out to greet him peaceably and to show him the burnt offering that was being offered for the king.
text_cn: 这些事过后，尼加诺尔上了熙雍山。有几位司祭和几位民间长老，从圣所里出来，和颜悦色地向他请安，并将为君王所献的全燔祭品，指给他看。

text_en: But he mocked them and derided them and defiled them and spoke arrogantly,
text_cn: 但他对那些人却加以轻慢、嘲笑、亵渎，还说了一些傲慢的话。

text_en: and in anger he swore this oath, “Unless Judas and his army are delivered into my hands this time, then if I return safely I will burn up this house. ” And he went out in great anger.
text_cn: 且又忿怒地发誓说：“犹大和他的军队，若不立即交在我手里，当我平安回来时，必要将这殿宇烧毁。”以后气愤地出去了。

text_en: At this the priests went in and stood before the altar and the temple; they wept and said,
text_cn: 司祭便进去，站在祭坛及圣殿前哭泣说：

text_en: “You chose this house to be called by your name, and to be for your people a house of prayer and supplication.
text_cn: “主啊！是你选择了这地方，使它因你的名而得名，作为你百姓祈祷呼吁的殿宇。

text_en: Take vengeance on this man and on his army, and let them fall by the sword; remember their blasphemies, and let them live no longer. ”
text_cn: 求你在这人和他的军队身上复仇，使他们死在刀剑下！你要记住他们的亵渎，不容他们存在！”

text_en: Now Nicanor went out from Jerusalem and encamped in Beth-horon, and the Syrian army joined him.
text_cn: 尼加诺尔撤出耶路撒冷，在贝特曷龙安营，在那里有一支叙利亚的军队与他会合。

text_en: Judas encamped in Adasa with three thousand men. Then Judas prayed and said,
text_cn: 犹大率领三千人，在阿达撒安营。 犹大祈祷说：

text_en: “When the messengers from the king spoke blasphemy, your angel went out and struck down one hundred eighty-five thousand of the Assyrians.
text_cn: “主啊！当亚述君王的兵士说亵渎话时，你的天使出来，杀死了他们十八万五千。

text_en: So also crush this army before us today; let the rest learn that Nicanor has spoken wickedly against the sanctuary, and judge him according to this wickedness. ”
text_cn: 今天，你也在我们面前，同样歼灭这支军队罢！使其余的人知道，他曾咒骂过你的圣所。请按他的恶行处罚他！”

text_en: So the armies met in battle on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar. The army of Nicanor was crushed, and he himself was the first to fall in the battle.
text_cn: “阿达尔”月十三日，双方军队交战，尼加诺尔的军队溃败，他自己首先阵亡了。

text_en: When his army saw that Nicanor had fallen, they threw down their arms and fled.
text_cn: 尼加诺尔的军队一见他死了，就弃甲逃走。

text_en: The Jews pursued them a day’s journey, from Adasa as far as Gazara, and as they followed they kept sounding the battle call on the trumpets.
text_cn: 犹太人追赶他们有一天的路程，从阿达撒一直追到革则尔，还在他们后边吹角为号，

text_en: People came out of all the surrounding villages of Judea, and they outflanked the enemy and drove them back to their pursuers, so that they all fell by the sword; not even one of them was left.
text_cn: 使四周的犹太人，都从各村镇出来，包围他们。于是敌军互相践踏，都丧身刀下，一个也没有留下。

text_en: Then the Jews seized the spoils and the plunder; they cut off Nicanor’s head and the right hand that he had so arrogantly stretched out, and brought them and displayed them just outside Jerusalem.
text_cn: 犹太人得了战利品和赃物，砍下尼加诺尔的头，和他傲慢伸过的右手，带回来，悬在耶路撒冷附近。

text_en: The people rejoiced greatly and celebrated that day as a day of great gladness.
text_cn: 百姓非常欢喜，庆祝那一天，有如喜庆的节日。

text_en: They decreed that this day should be celebrated each year on the thirteenth day of Adar.
text_cn: 于是规定每年“阿达尔”月十三日为庆日。

text_en: So the land of Judah had rest for a few days.
text_cn: 犹太地遂平安了一个时期。
